title: Democratic socialist Angie Nixon clinches surprise primary win in Florida US Senate race
summary_full: Nixon bested Alexander Vindman to win Democratic nomination and now faces Republican Ashley Moody in NovemberTrump-backed Byron Donalds wins Republican primary in race to succeed Florida governor DeSantisIn an upset for the Democratic establishment, progressive Angie Nixon won the party’s US Senate primary in Florida, beating former army intelligence officer Alexander Vindman.Nixon, a state representative and member of the Democratic Socialists of America, had significantly less funding going into the primary – with $975,000 to Vindman’s $16.3m at the end of July, according to Florida Politics.
